title: Fix errors caused by merging `Rect2i` without area in `RichRextLabel`

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

I haven't seen an exact issue regarding this problem but in one of my games, I got errors stating regularly:
```
E 0:00:17:413   merge: Rect2i size is negative, this is not supported. Use Rect2i.abs() to get a Rect2i with a positive size.
  <C++ Source>  ./core/math/rect2i.h:111 @ merge()
```

But they didn't cause my game to not function properly (at least in debug mode). So I focused on other things. However now I run into the issue that `[shy]` tags in BBCode wouldn't function in my release exports and I thought those errors might be related. So I checked the source code of RichTextLabel and figured my quick fix here would help. It actually gets rid of all the error messages I saw previously.

It would be nice to see this merged and I don't think it should cause any regressions for others. The only thing my change does: It protects the RichTextLabel from merging Rect2i with negative or zero sizes.

## Additional information

I'm not sure yet whether it fixes my issue with `[shy]` tags in release exports. If not, I will likely look into this further since it kind of breaks text formatting in my game.
